keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Sporting Kansas City 0, FC Dallas 1. Herman Johansson (FC Dallas) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ran Binyamin following a fast break.
Delay in match (Sporting Kansas City).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Lalas Abubakar (FC Dallas) is shown the yellow card.
Jacob Bartlett (Sporting Kansas City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Goal! Sporting Kansas City 1, FC Dallas 1. Jansen Miller (Sporting Kansas City) header from the left side of the six yard box to the top left corner. Assisted by Owen Wolff with a cross following a set piece situation.
Substitution, FC Dallas. Petar Musa replaces Santiago Moreno.
Sebastien Ibeagha (FC Dallas) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Owen Wolff (Sporting Kansas City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Sporting Kansas City. Stephen Afrifa replaces Rubén Ramos.
Substitution, Sporting Kansas City. Calvin Harris replaces Capita.
Substitution, Sporting Kansas City. Lasse Berg Johnsen replaces Owen Wolff.
Jake Davis (Sporting Kansas City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, FC Dallas. Bernard Kamungo replaces Herman Johansson.
Substitution, FC Dallas. Christian Cappis replaces Ramiro.
Substitution, FC Dallas. Sam Sarver replaces Daniel Job.
Osaze Urhoghide (FC Dallas) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Sporting Kansas City. Jayden Reid replaces Emir Karic.
Sam Sarver (FC Dallas) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Jacob Bartlett (Sporting Kansas City).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Sporting Kansas City. Ian James replaces Jacob Bartlett because of an injury.
Substitution, FC Dallas. Anderson Julio replaces Joaquín Valiente.
Penalty saved. Petar Musa (FC Dallas) right footed shot saved in the bottom left corner by Stefan Cleveland (Sporting Kansas City).
Second Half ends, Sporting Kansas City 1, FC Dallas 1.
